headwords.text: To find yourself on a roof in a dream, denotes unbounded success. To become frightened and think you are falling, signifies that, while you may advance, you will have no firm hold on your position. To see a roof falling in, you will be threatened with a sudden calamity. To repair, or build a roof, you will rapidly increase your fortune. To sleep on one, proclaims your security against enemies and false companions. Your health will be robust.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `roof`(지붕, 문맥 0개이던 자리)에 다섯 그림을 채운다

headwords.text: To see a person dressed in mourning sitting on a roof corner, foretells there will be unexpected and dismal failures in your business. Affairs will appear unfavorable in love.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `roof-corner`(지붕 모서리) — 한 그림(두 문장을 이어 하나로 묶음)

headwords.text: To dream of rooks, denotes that while your friends are true, they will not afford you the pleasure and contentment for which you long, as your thoughts and tastes will outstrip their humble conception of life. A dead rook, denotes sickness or death in your immediate future.
headwords.note: 새 상징 `rook`(떼까마귀) — 두 그림. 기존 `crow`(까마귀)·`jackdaw`(갈까마귀)와 다른 까마귓과 종이라 따로 세운다

headwords.text: To dream of a rooster, foretells that you will be very successful and rise to prominence, but you will allow yourself to become conceited over your fortunate rise. To see roosters fighting, foretells altercations and rivals.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `chicken`(닭)에 두 그림을 더한다 — 원문 각주 [194] 'See Chickens' 그대로 따른다

headwords.text: To dream of seeing roots of plants or trees, denotes misfortune, as both business and health will go into decline. To use them as medicine, warns you of approaching illness or sorrow.

Ropes in dreams, signify perplexities and complications in affairs, and uncertain love making. If you climb one, you will overcome enemies who are working to injure you. To decend{sic} a rope, brings disappointment to your most sanguine moments. If you are tied with them, you are likely to yield to love contrary to your judgment.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `rope`(밧줄)에 둘만 더한다(오르기·내려가기) — 「밧줄은 혼란」은 기존 「밧줄을 봄」(길)과 같은 그림·정반대 극성, 「밧줄에 묶임」은 기존 「밧줄이 몸을 묶음」(길)과 같은 그림·정반대 극성이라 둘 다 뺀다(skipped_sentences)
